warning.titlePre: Mercedes Sprinter 413–519 CDI Known Issues by Engine
paragraphs: If your Sprinter 413–519 CDI has the OM651 4-cylinder diesel (the 2.1-litre unit), injector seal leaks and timing chain wear are a well-established pattern across the wider Mercedes commercial vehicle range. We replace injector seals and timing chain components as standard on every OM651 rebuild.

If your Sprinter 413–519 CDI has the OM642 V6 diesel (the 3.0-litre unit), swirl flap and injector wear is a documented pattern on this engine. We replace worn swirl flaps, injector seals and gaskets as standard on every OM642 rebuild.
warning.source: Source: established commercial vehicle specialist pattern, per VRF-mercedes-sprinter.md. Both engine codes confirmed with separate known issues
